title: Number of Unique Flavors After Sharing K Candies
goal: Keep the most distinct flavors after giving away one contiguous block of k candies.
strategy: Maintain frequencies outside the shared block. Moving that block right restores its old left candy and removes its new right candy; the number of positive counts is the remaining variety.
